compose.title: Whyboard — Why did rides spike at 8am?
compose.description: One MCP call (`glyph_whyboard`) returns a deterministic tree: a root that answers the question, then one branch per diagnostic (anomaly, decompose, forecast). Every node carries a chained `DataHandle` — click it, query it, drill in. This is the same example shown on the Glyph homepage.
